title: Money Market Junior
summary: An illustrated 2D market where learners shop for a picnic within a fixed budget, computing totals and change.
mobileSupportNote: Full shopping and checkout flow works at 390px: basket is a fixed bottom bar (collapsed) / bottom sheet (open) with the running total always visible; token placement is tap-based. Mouse/pen users additionally get drag-to-basket.

cover.alt: Staged market moment on tablet-width layout: stalls with price-tag stickers, a basket holding strawberries, bananas and lemonade totalling 19 of a 30-token budget with the coin strip and budget bar visible.

desktop.alt: Honest desktop landing state: deep-green market sign band with four mission tabs, the four stall aisle with eight products, and an empty basket panel with budget bar on the right.

tablet.alt: Tablet hero view (1024x768): stall aisle with striped scalloped awnings on the left and the sticky basket column with requirement chips on the right.

mobile.alt: Mobile landing state at 390px: sign band, mission brief and first stalls, with the pinned bottom basket bar showing an empty basket and 30 tokens left.
